title: OpenSCAD parametric block exported to STL, 3MF, SVG and PNG and measured against analytic values
summary: OpenSCAD 2026.10.11 snapshot: one .scad with -D overrides to STL on Manifold and CGAL, checked by trimesh against analytic volume; SVG footprint, fixed-camera 400x300 PNG. KNOWN FAIL: 3MF is not byte-identical across runs; CGAL STL volume off by 3e-9.
